Option (B) says: “They were the secretary’s secretary” — that would require “their” to refer to “secretary,” but “secretary” hasn’t been mentioned before “their,” so that’s not possible here.  
Option (C) “Ambiguous” — not correct, because the only grammatically sensible antecedent is “my parent.”
